The session is isolated to the plugin's tools, w"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ith no shell, file system or network, so every number in the answer comes from the engine, and the a"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"gent stops and asks when the conditions are insufficient."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"All calculation happens inside a deterministic **engine**. The agent writes typed values into slots,"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" calls one of 38 built-in solvers, and reads the result back; the engine converts units at the calcu"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"lation boundary and records every step into a readable record."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| primitive | effect |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `set` | writes one typed value into a slot |
| `get` | reads one slot back |
| `call` | runs a reg"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"istered solver and stores its result |
| `solver_info` | returns a solver's signature before it is c"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"alled |
| `record_question` / `record_analyse` / `record_answer` | bracket a solve into a record |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The catalog covers expression algebra, series, transfer functions, DSP and DFT, signal quality, circ"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"uits, electronics, RF and Smith chart, transmission lines, noise and filter design."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Records"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Settled records are listed in the client panel's **Records** tab, refreshed every 5 s, and a record "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"that was never sealed is marked incomplete. Opening one shows its timeline: a collapsible card per w"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"rite, read, call and failure, values as JSON trees, the toolbar and title fixed while the timeline s"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"crolls. The list supports multi-select and delete."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"A record is the process of one solve: every step reads on its own, and a solve that was interrupted "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"continues from its record after a host restart."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Article generation"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Each record can be written up as a standalone solution article. The host LLM writes it from the trac"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"e — question, conditions, analysis, solver steps with their arguments and results, and the final ans"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"wer — in the model's own voice, never mentioning the plugin."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| format | output |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Markdown | a flat `.md` file, never compiled |
| LaTeX | a XeLaTeX document, compiled to PDF by a "},{"id":"p21s2","text":" flat `.md` file, never compiled |
| LaTeX | a XeLaTeX document, compiled to PDF by a LaTeX driver |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The setup dialog remembers the article language, the output directory and the file name. Compilation"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" needs latexmk or MiKTeX's texify together with the `xelatex` engine, and the dialog checks the tool"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"chain once per host start: without a usable driver Generate is disabled with the reason shown. A run"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" is cancellable, and its progress dialog minimizes to a corner pill that survives navigation. The ar"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ticle or its folder can be opened from that dialog."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## External solvers"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Beyond the built-in catalog you can register solvers of your own, reached over http. A declaration l"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ives in `~/.dsh-electro-lab/external-solvers.jsonl` and is compiled into the solver registry at engi"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ne start, so `solver_info` and `call` treat it like a built-in."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| way to declare | how |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| the panel | **External solvers** tab: list, add, edit, enable, disable, delete |
| the agent | `ex"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ternal_solver_add`, `external_solver_update`, `external_solver_delete` |
| the file | edit the archi"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"_add`, `external_solver_update`, `external_solver_delete` |
| the file | edit the archive directly |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"A declaration carries a name, a description, the parameters, an explicit `returns` shape and the end"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"point, and it may be written in the panel's guided form. Changes apply after a host restart, and the"},{"id":"p27s3","text":" panel shows a pending-restart notice until then."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The peer answers a POST of `{ "requestId": …, "args": … }` with `{ "requestId": …, "result": … }`, o"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"r with `{ "requestId": …, "error": "…" }` to report a failure. Arguments and results are typed value"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"s, so units travel as SI numbers rather than as symbols or unit words."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Engine manual §6 holds the full contract, and `external-solvers-example/` is a runnable peer with a "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"field-by-field register guide."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| setting | meaning |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| `DSH_ELECTRO_LAB_HOME` | the plugin home, `~/.dsh-electro-lab` by default |
| `DSH_ELECTRO_LAB_LOG"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"_LEVEL` | `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error` or `off`; default `info` |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The home holds the records, the declaration archive, the plugin state and one log file per host run."},{"id":"p33s2","text":" Both are described in the engine manual: storage and logs."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Documentation"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| document | content |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"| Engine manual · 简体中文 | typed values, primitives, the solver catalog, external solvers, storage, lo"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"gs |
